sentence: This project studies how adding an enzyme breaks down charged polymer complexes that could deliver two drugs with separate release rates.
This project builds imaging systems and computer methods that help underwater vehicles see, map the sea floor and navigate.
This project studies how doubling all the genetic information in a cell produces traits in two plant species from the sunflower family.
This project uses ultrafast laser pulses to study how electronic charge gets distributed in small molecules after excitation by light.
This project builds a system that combines intuitive and deliberate visual processing to give artificial intelligence more robust visual intelligence.
This project adds research on microbial host-interaction and molecular genetics to two biology laboratory courses.
This project builds a cybersecurity community of practice with hands-on learning and competency-based skills development.
This project builds a framework that measures the toxicity of computer hardware waste so designers can choose less toxic designs.
This project develops a 3D printing method that places nanoparticles and polymers precisely, layer by layer, to build very small structures.
This project tests a light-based wearable device that measures blood glucose without breaking the skin.
This project studies how algae and bacteria growing together help each other and how that speeds up the cleaning of wastewater.
This project studies how two prions in yeast interact and how that affects global transcription and protein-homeostasis in yeast cells.
This project studies how ciliates that live without oxygen in the sea partner with bacteria and archaea, and what each partner does.
This project refines a hands-on learning game in which teams solve cybersecurity puzzles to open a locked box protected by a security system.
This project develops hollow glass bubbles on a chip, filled or coated with highly nonlinear materials, that generate classical and quantum light.
This project studies how chlorine and fuel react in drinking water to form harmful disinfection byproducts, and how quickly.
This project builds lessons that use 3D printing and biomimicry engineering design to teach science and engineering in rural schools.
